name: replay_frame_stamps
description: Harness self-test, not a design target: a probe node (tests/replay/probe/frame_probe.gd) logs in _ready and on each of its first physics frames, before the runner does. Every stamp must be its own tick minus one, so the level's ready (frame -2) and the warm-up frame (-1) never share stamps with frames 0 and up, and a scenario acting on frame 0 measures its windows in full.
